inputs.description: Default Kusto cluster URI (e.g., https://help.kusto.windows.net/ or your cluster).
Default database name for Kusto queries (e.g., Samples).
Azure OpenAI embeddings endpoint for shots/semantic search (format: https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/<name>/embeddings?api-version=<version>;impersonate).
JSON array of preconfigured Kusto services (e.g., [{"service_uri":"https://cluster.kusto.windows.net","default_database":"DB"}]).
Whether to eagerly connect to the default service on startup (true/false).
Allow connections to services not listed in KUSTO_KNOWN_SERVICES (true/false).
Base URL for Fabric APIs (default https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/v1).
